dedication: Dedicated to the people who made the textmode scene.
work_missing: This work is not in the museum, or no longer.
work_not_shown: The museum keeps the record of this work but does not show it here.
work_unreviewed: rated by a program, not yet reviewed by a person
work_words_none: No words were found in this work.
work_words_note: Read from the grid by a program; letters drawn with blocks are not read yet.
cell_hint: Zoom in and point at a cell to see how it is made.
cell_byte: Written by byte {byte}, {time} into the arrival
help_arrows: previous or next in the pack
help_signature: another work with the same signature
help_zoom: zoom in, zoom out, fit to the screen
help_swipe: On a phone, swipe left or right to move through the pack.
atlas_intro: Explore the works, their words and their relationships. Every discovery belongs here.
atlas_unavailable: This collection could not be loaded.
atlas_train: This exploration uses the training corpus. Held-out packs remain unexamined. Figures describe the stated dataset version; display eligibility is checked by the server.
atlas_science_note: Measurements and interpretations enrich this work. They retain their methods, sources and limitations.
atlas_similarity_note: Computed proximity from features v1, not a claim of influence or authorship.
atlas_no_readings: No signed reading is available in this language yet.
atlas_reports_note: These dated studies describe their original datasets. Their results and negative findings are part of the museum, with methods and limitations.
atlas_vision_note: Vision readings appear beside their works when a signed analysis exists. Opening the museum never calls a model.
atlas_original_language: Source text in its original language
atlas_graph_missing: The constellation is unavailable for this collection.
atlas_graph_find: Highlight an artist, group or pack
